# Issue #38244: when building for Windows with -buildmode=c-shared
# and no -o flag, the output file should have a .dll extension.

[compiler:gccgo] skip 'gccgo does not cross-compile to windows here'

# Cross-compile with -n so that no C toolchain for Windows is needed.
env GOOS=windows
env GOARCH=amd64
env CGO_ENABLED=1

go build -n -buildmode=c-shared
stderr ' -o mylib\.dll '
stderr '^mv \$WORK[/\\]b001[/\\]exe[/\\]mylib\.dll mylib\.dll$'

# An explicit -o name is used as is.
go build -n -buildmode=c-shared -o other.dll
stderr ' -o other\.dll '
stderr '^mv \$WORK[/\\]b001[/\\]exe[/\\]other\.dll other\.dll$'

go build -n -buildmode=c-shared -o noext
stderr ' -o noext '
stderr '^mv \$WORK[/\\]b001[/\\]exe[/\\]noext noext$'

# Build for real on Windows hosts that support c-shared.
[!GOOS:windows] stop
[short] stop
[!cgo] stop
[!buildmode:c-shared] stop

env GOOS=
env GOARCH=
env CGO_ENABLED=

go build -buildmode=c-shared
exists mylib.dll
exists mylib.h
! exists mylib

-- go.mod --
module example.com/mylib

go 1.27
-- main.go --
package main

import "C"

//export Hello
func Hello() {}

func main() {}
